none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize a convex population objective f over all of ℝᵈ. At every oracle step k, f is the pointwise expectation of integrable convex C∞ sample losses. All sample losses share a global minimizer u with ‖x₀−u‖≤R.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query at x returns one sample gradient g(x,ξ) using a fresh i.i.d. seed. Its mean belongs to ∂f(x). Every sample returns the same vector g₀ at x₀ and zero at u. The algorithm receives the gradient vector. The sample loss, seed, sampling law, u, and g₀ are outside the public input.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedDistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, Interpolates; LongTails/Setups/DistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, spec.publicInput and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean, Public and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: The same oracle also accepts a projection query. Euclidean projection onto the whole space returns the query point. Each gradient or projection query uses one call from the same fixed budget. The setup permits arbitrary adaptive randomized algorithms.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean, Query and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedDistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, Interpolates; LongTails/Setups/DistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, spec; LongTails/Template.lean, Setup.allowedAlgorithm, Algorithm and executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: The raw second moment satisfies E‖g(x,ξ)‖²≤G²+B²‖x−x₀‖² for every x. This permits heavy tails and bounds the second moment in terms of distance from the public starting point.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The domain is the full Euclidean space ℝᵈ for every public dimension d≥2.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean, Vector and Public; LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedDistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, Interpolates and spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Interpolation and exact agreement at initialization hold simultaneously for every step and every seed. The C∞ condition on sample losses specifies no uniform Lipschitz constant for their gradients. The public parameters are d, x₀, B, G, R, ε, and δ, with B≥0, G,R,ε>0, 65536ε≤GR, and 0<δ≤1/8.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The terminal output x̂ must be measurable and feasible for every realization. Its target is f(x̂)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. The algorithm may output any point computed from its state.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DistanceGrowingSubgradient.lean, spec.successful; LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean, spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm.output and execute.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Under the product law of the algorithm seed and the oracle seed sequence, Pr[f(x̂)−f(x⋆)>ε]≤δ.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Every sample gradient agrees at the public starting point and vanishes at a shared hidden minimizer, while its second moment elsewhere can grow quadratically with distance from the starting point.
